Timed work samples fluency; it does not replace understanding. Choose a mixed
set, hide feedback until the end, record the time limit before starting, and
stop when time expires. Review every item afterward, including correct answers
reached through fragile reasoning.

::: {.callout-warning}
Timed results are local practice evidence, not a grade, credential, or prediction
of performance in another setting.
:::
